The Commission noticed that the Petitioner has provided the rebate to the Respondents considering adversities faced by the Respondent beneficiaries on account of COVID – 19 pandemic, based on the communication of the MOP, GOI, as stated above. It is pertinent to mention that the communication of MOP, GOI is advisory in nature and cannot be said to be a mandate on the Petitioner. The Petitioner having granted rebate based on the said communication cannot seek to recover the same through the tariff order. Accordingly, the claim of the Petitioner is **not allowed** . _Order in Petition No. 244/GT/2020 Page 46 of_ **_53_** _Order in Petition No. 244/GT/2020 Page 47 of_ **_53_** _Order in Petition No. 244/GT/2020 Page 48 of_ **_53_**
